title: The Pirate Pharmacy Question
blurb: Which parts of medicine could actually be made at city-to-community scale, and how soon? We scored nine domains on societal benefit against demonstrated small-scale feasibility — and found the bottleneck is almost never synthesis. It is sterility and quality control. The highest-leverage build is not a new reactor; it is an open QC commons. Every academic claim verified against Crossref/OpenAlex, one retracted source caught and excluded.
source: landscape synthesis by Matilde; 14 academic citations 4-axis verified (Crossref/OpenAlex/retraction), community claims attributed to primary pages
